voicing.note: Chord names played as voiced chords: chord("<Am7 Fmaj7>").voicing() instead of written-out notes.

chord.note: Chord symbols for voicing(): the progression as an idea.

beat.note: Sequencer steps: beat("0,4,11", 16) instead of a written-out rhythm.

sometimes.note: Seeded variation on some events (an effect, a note up an octave).

sometimesBy.note: Like sometimes, with a chance that can follow a radio curve.

every.note: A change every n cycles: fills, turnarounds.

lastOf.note: A fill on the last cycle of a phrase.

iter.note: Rotates a pattern each cycle: one idea, many bars.

chooseCycles.note: Seeded choice between ideas, one per cycle.

off.note: A shifted, transformed copy of a line (echoes, harmonies).

ply.note: Repeats each event: a build-up move.

rib.note: Loops a slice of a seeded random pattern: n(irand(8).seg(16).rib(3, 2)).

seg.note: Samples a continuous pattern into steps (with irand, perlin).

irand.note: Seeded random integers: scale degrees, sample slices.

perlin.note: Smooth seeded movement for filters and levels.

pick.note: Picks named ideas by a pattern of indices.

duck.note: Sidechain ducking of one bus by another, instead of written gain steps.

lpenv.note: Filter envelope depth: a filter that opens per note.

fmh.note: FM harmonicity ratio: new timbres from the same synth.

fm2.note: Second FM operator (fm2 to fm8 are the multi-operator FM).

scrub.note: Plays a sample from a position: textures and stutters.

ir.note: Impulse response reverb from a sample: rooms that differ by style.

S$:.note: Line label (solo), not a function: a section built in solo before the others come back.
